rows.en:
(Swimming's next, huh.
Perfect pool weather.)
Ranka, you've got swimming too, huh?
Yep, that's right.
Make sure you warm up properly.
I already did with Nana-chan!
Okay, coming~
rows.notes: Ranka, answering someone calling her (presumably Nanase).

rows.en: Well then, I'm off to swim.
(Ranka's always so full of energy.)

(Swimming's next...
Perfect pool weather!)
Ranka-chan, so you've got swimming too.
Then you're all set.
rows.notes: Female, answering Ranka's 'I already did with Nana-chan!'.

rows.en: (Ranka-chan's always so full of energy~)
(I'll go to the restroom while it's break time.)
Ranka, what's wrong?

Looks like you're looking for someone.
Want me to go get them?

...A-actually, I left my math assignment at home...
I wanted to redo it before next class...

I see.
If mine's okay, I can lend it to you.

Really?
Would you mind?
Sure, wait a sec.
Huh? Where's your notebook?

...I forgot mine too.
And I've got that class this afternoon...
...Whaaat?!
Guess we'll have to go borrow one...
rows.notes: Male. Both now need one; 'we' chosen.

rows.en: (Sigh... I wonder if anyone will lend me theirs...)
(I'll go to the restroom while it's break time.)

Ranka-chaan, what's wrong?
You're looking all over the place.

I see...
If mine's okay, I can lend it to you.
Sure, wait just a sec.

...I forgot mine too~
And I've got that class this afternoon...
Guess we'll have to go borrow one...

(That was a long morning...
I'm so hungry...)
What a noise...
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders. The player's stomach growled.

rows.en:
Ranka...
Did you just hear that?

That's the first time I've ever heard
a stomach growl that loud.

I haven't eaten anything since last night.
I'm starving...

I'll share my lunch with you,
so cheer up!
R-really?
Yeah, I made a little extra.

R-Ranka...
I'll never forget this kindness as long as I live...
not until the day I die...
Sheesh... You're so overdramatic.

(Ranka's lunch was delicious...
Time to give the afternoon classes my all.)

(That was a long morning...
I'm sooo hungry...)

Ranka-chan...
Did you hear that just now, by any chance?

I haven't eaten anything since last night...
I'm totally starving...

R-Rangga-jaaan...
I'll never forget this kindness
as long as I live...
rows.notes: Female. 'Ranga-jan' = Ranka-chan blubbered through tears; kept distorted.

rows.en:
(Ranka-chan's lunch was delicious...
Time to give the afternoon classes my all.)

(School's finally over for today...
Maybe I'll stop somewhere on the way home?)

Oh, who's that over there...
Ranka!

\p-kun,
what's up?

Want to go somewhere now?
We could invite Alto and the others.
Sorry... I've got my part-time job after this.
Nah, I'm used to it by now.
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders; answers 'that sounds rough' (c19456 in the female scene).

rows.en:
Oh, sorry for holding you up.
Aren't you short on time?

Yikes! Okay, I'll get going.
Come hang out at Nyan-Nyan too, okay?

(A part-time job, huh...
Maybe I'll try getting one someday.)

(School's finally over for today...
Maybe I'll stop somewhere on the way home~?)

Oh, who's that over there...
Ranka-chaan!

\p-chan,
what's up?

Want to go somewhere now?
We could invite Nanase and the others.
rows.notes: Female. Bare 'Nanase' as in the Japanese.

rows.en: I see~ That sounds rough.

Oh, sorry for holding you up.
Do you have time?

(A part-time job, huh...
Maybe I'll try getting one someday.)

uncertain: c19419 / c19426: kariru shika nai ka read as 'we' (both the player and Ranka now lack the assignment); the next thought is the player's own.
c19441: the female player's tearful 'Ranga-jan' rendered 'Rangga-jaaan'.
c19448: Ranka's 'No, I'm used to it' answers a line present only in the female scene (c19456); in the male scene the matching line seems to be cut or a choice.
